context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: こみ/削る/利く/扱える/照らさ/考え直し/挙がっ/緩め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、人こみの中で交渉する経験、するんだ。
lines.en: Ren — you're going to get experience negotiating in crowded situations.
lines.style: Calm, directional tone. Measured pace. The casual certainty of someone who knows what needs to happen next. Sets expectation without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経費、無駄を削る、社会人の基本ですね。
lines.en: Yes. Cutting costs, eliminating waste — that's the foundation of being a professional.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly. Quick, earnest delivery. Each clause stacked like he's building something. Seeking affirmation through clarity, not doubt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機転が利く社員、育てたい。
lines.en: I want to develop staff who can think on their feet.
lines.style: Slight pause before speaking, like he's choosing words carefully. Quiet conviction. Not a demand — an articulation of what matters to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 多様な案件を扱える人材、目指します。
lines.en: I'm aiming to become the kind of person who can handle all kinds of cases.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful delivery. Slight nod within the words. Sincere without overstatement. The tone of someone making a promise to himself as much as to the listener.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: スポットライトに照らされる存在、ではなく、地道な人になれ。
lines.en: Don't become someone in the spotlight — become someone who does the work day after day.
lines.style: Slower pace on the first half. Weight lands on 'day after day.' Not lecturing — sharing something he's learned. The warmth of someone who sees potential.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 進路、もう一度、考え直しています。
lines.en: I'm thinking through my path again.
lines.style: Quiet, introspective. Slight hesitation on 'again' — acknowledging this isn't the first time he's done this. Soft, not defeated. The vulnerability of reconsidering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 課題、挙がってきたら、すぐ相談しろ。
lines.en: When problems come up, talk to me right away.
lines.style: Direct, unambiguous. No softening. But the tone underneath is permissive — an invitation to trust, not a warning. Practical care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩、締め切り、少し緩めにしてもらえますか。
lines.en: Yes. Senpai, could you give me a bit more time on the deadline?
lines.style: Polite but genuine. A small, careful breath before the request. Not apologetic — just asking directly. The tone of someone who knows he's overextended.
